customer_concentration.grouping_method: Economic customer grouped to parent_customer_id when present, otherwise customer_id.

retention.methodology: Monthly ARR rolled to economic customer using parent_customer_id when present. Starting cohort defined as economic customers with ARR > 0 at 2025-01-01. NRR = ending ARR of starting cohort / beginning ARR. GRR = min(beginning ARR, ending ARR) aggregated across starting cohort / beginning ARR. Logo churn = churned logos / starting logos, where churned logos have beginning ARR > 0 and ending ARR = 0.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Revenue measured at invoice-line grain for FY2025. Management-tagged recurring revenue uses revenue_type text containing recurring or subscription. Independently restated recurring revenue requires recurring/subscription evidence from delivery_model or revenue_type plus non-null service period start and end. Amounts tagged recurring but lacking independent structured support are treated as reclassified; rows lacking sufficient recurring indicators are preserved as ambiguous/non-recurring depending on available evidence.

collections_quality.dso_methodology: Weighted average invoice collection days for FY2025 invoices using invoice_amount_usd * days_outstanding over invoices with payment_date present. Unpaid invoices are excluded from DSO numerator/denominator and separately disclosed. Aging buckets use FY2025 invoice_date to either payment timing for paid invoices or age as of 2025-12-31 for unpaid invoices.

customer_tenure.population: Top 10 FY2025 economic customers by revenue

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.

metric_evidence.metric: Revenue by period and revenue CAGR
metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_base AS ( SELECT YEAR(i.invoice_date) AS fiscal_year, COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, i.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, COALESCE(pcust.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS economic_customer_name, l.invoice_line_id, l.line_amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer pcust ON c.parent_customer_id = pcust.customer_id ), yearly AS ( SELECT fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(line_amount_usd),2) AS total_revenue_usd, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM revenue_base GROUP BY fiscal_year ), cagr AS ( SELECT ROUND(100 * (POWER(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN total_revenue_usd END) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN total_revenue_usd END), 1.0 / 2) - 1), 4) AS revenue_cagr_pct, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN total_revenue_usd END) AS start_revenue_usd, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN total_revenue_usd END) AS end_revenue_usd FROM yearly ) SELECT 'yearly_revenue' AS metric_type, CAST(fiscal_year AS STRING) AS period, total_revenue_usd, line_count, NULL AS extra_1, NULL AS extra_2 FROM yearly UNION ALL SELECT 'revenue_cagr' AS metric_type, '2023-2025' AS period, revenue_cagr_pct AS total_revenue_usd, NULL AS line_count, start_revenue_usd AS extra_1, end_revenue_usd AS extra_2 FROM cagr ORDER BY metric_type, period
metric_evidence.methodology: Used invoice-line grain joined to invoice header for invoice_date. Revenue aggregated by YEAR(invoice_date). CAGR calculated fully in SQL from 2023 and 2025 revenue over two annual periods.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_2025 AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, i.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, COALESCE(pcust.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS economic_customer_name, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer pcust ON c.parent_customer_id = pcust.customer_id WHERE YEAR(i.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, i.customer_id), COALESCE(pcust.customer_name, c.customer_name) ), ranked AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, economic_customer_name, revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, economic_customer_id) AS rn, SUM(revenue_usd) OVER () AS total_revenue_usd FROM revenue_2025 ) SELECT rn, economic_customer_id, economic_customer_name, ROUND(revenue_usd,2) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(100 * revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd,4) AS revenue_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 1 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) OVER () / total_revenue_usd,4) AS top_1_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 3 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) OVER () / total_revenue_usd,4) AS top_3_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 5 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) OVER () / total_revenue_usd,4) AS top_5_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) OVER () / total_revenue_usd,4) AS top_10_pct FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY rn
metric_evidence.methodology: FY2025 invoice-line revenue summed to economic customer using parent roll-up where available. Concentration percentages calculated in SQL against total FY2025 revenue.

metric_evidence.metric: FY2025 ARR bridge, NRR, GRR, and logo churn
metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, s.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, s.snapshot_month, SUM(s.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month s LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, s.customer_id), s.snapshot_month ), cohort AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE '2025-01-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS beginning_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE '2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ending_arr FROM monthly GROUP BY economic_customer_id ), movements AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, beginning_arr, ending_arr, CASE WHEN beginning_arr = 0 AND ending_arr > 0 THEN ending_arr ELSE 0 END AS new_logo_arr, CASE WHEN beginning_arr > 0 AND ending_arr > beginning_arr THEN ending_arr - beginning_arr ELSE 0 END AS expansion_arr, CASE WHEN beginning_arr > 0 AND ending_arr < beginning_arr AND ending_arr > 0 THEN beginning_arr - ending_arr ELSE 0 END AS contraction_arr, CASE WHEN beginning_arr > 0 AND ending_arr = 0 THEN beginning_arr ELSE 0 END AS churned_arr, CASE WHEN beginning_arr = 0 AND ending_arr > 0 THEN 0 ELSE ending_arr END AS retained_arr, CASE WHEN beginning_arr > 0 AND ending_arr = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS churned_logo, CASE WHEN beginning_arr > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starting_logo FROM cohort ), totals AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(beginning_arr),2) AS beginning_arr, ROUND(SUM(new_logo_arr),2) AS new_logo_arr, ROUND(SUM(expansion_arr),2) AS expansion_arr, ROUND(SUM(contraction_arr),2) AS contraction_arr, ROUND(SUM(churned_arr),2) AS churned_arr, ROUND(SUM(ending_arr),2) AS ending_arr, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN beginning_arr > 0 THEN ending_arr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(beginning_arr),0),4) AS nrr_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN beginning_arr > 0 THEN LEAST(beginning_arr, ending_arr) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(beginning_arr),0),4) AS grr_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(churned_logo) / NULLIF(SUM(starting_logo),0),4) AS logo_churn_pct, SUM(starting_logo) AS starting_logo_count, SUM(churned_logo) AS churned_logo_count FROM movements ) SELECT * FROM totals
metric_evidence.methodology: Economic customer ARR is aggregated monthly using parent roll-up where present. FY2025 bridge compares 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-01 snapshots. New logo ARR is ARR from customers with zero beginning ARR and positive ending ARR. Expansion, contraction, and churn are derived from start/end ARR deltas. NRR, GRR, and logo churn are computed fully in SQL for the starting cohort.

metric_evidence.query: WITH recurring_base AS ( SELECT YEAR(i.invoice_date) AS fiscal_year, l.line_amount_usd, l.revenue_type, p.delivery_model, p.product_family, l.service_period_start, l.service_period_end FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id WHERE YEAR(i.invoice_date) = 2025 ) SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_amount_usd),2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(revenue_type) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(revenue_type) LIKE '%subscription%' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(revenue_type) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(revenue_type) LIKE '%subscription%' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(line_amount_usd),0),4) AS management_tagged_recurring_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS restated_recurring_revenue, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(line_amount_usd),0),4) AS restated_recurring_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(revenue_type) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(revenue_type) LIKE '%subscription%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS reclassified_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type IS NULL OR ((LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) NOT LIKE '%recurr%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) NOT LIKE '%subscription%') AND (service_period_start IS NULL OR service_period_end IS NULL) AND LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) NOT LIKE '%subscription%') THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM recurring_base
metric_evidence.methodology: Invoice-line revenue was classified two ways: management-tagged recurring based on recorded revenue_type text, and independently supported recurring using available structured evidence requiring recurring/subscription signal plus valid service periods. Ambiguity is preserved where data does not support independent recurring treatment.

metric_evidence.query: WITH paid AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, i.invoice_date, i.invoice_amount_usd, c.payment_date, c.amount_paid_usd, c.days_outstanding FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection c ON i.invoice_id = c.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(i.invoice_date) = 2025 ), dso AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL THEN invoice_amount_usd * days_outstanding ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL THEN invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),0),4) AS weighted_avg_days_outstanding, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS unpaid_invoice_amount, COUNT(*) AS invoice_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoice_count FROM paid ), aging AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) <= 30 THEN '1-30_unpaid_days' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60_unpaid_days' WHEN DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', invoice_date) <= 90 THEN '61-90_unpaid_days' ELSE '90+_unpaid_days' END ELSE CASE WHEN days_outstanding <= 30 THEN '0-30_paid_days' WHEN days_outstanding <= 60 THEN '31-60_paid_days' WHEN days_outstanding <= 90 THEN '61-90_paid_days' ELSE '90+_paid_days' END END AS aging_bucket, ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS invoice_amount_usd, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM paid GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT 'dso' AS metric_type, CAST(weighted_avg_days_outstanding AS STRING) AS metric_value, CAST(unpaid_invoice_amount AS STRING) AS aux_1, CAST(invoice_rows AS STRING) AS aux_2, CAST(unpaid_invoice_count AS STRING) AS aux_3 FROM dso UNION ALL SELECT aging_bucket AS metric_type, CAST(invoice_amount_usd AS STRING) AS metric_value, CAST(invoice_count AS STRING) AS aux_1, NULL AS aux_2, NULL AS aux_3 FROM aging
metric_evidence.methodology: For FY2025 invoices, DSO is computed as weighted average days_outstanding using invoice_amount_usd as weights for invoices with payment dates. Unpaid invoices are separately disclosed. Aging buckets distinguish paid collection timing and unpaid invoice age as of 2025-12-31.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_2025 AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, i.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE YEAR(i.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, i.customer_id) ), ranked AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, economic_customer_id) AS rn FROM revenue_2025 ), tenure AS ( SELECT r.economic_customer_id, dc.customer_name, dc.first_order_date, ROUND(DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', dc.first_order_date) / 365.25, 4) AS tenure_years, r.rn FROM ranked r JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON r.economic_customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE r.rn <= 10 ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(tenure_years),4) AS avg_tenure_years, COUNT(*) AS top_customer_count FROM tenure
metric_evidence.methodology: Top 10 economic customers are ranked by FY2025 invoice-line revenue. Tenure is measured from first_order_date to 2025-12-31 in years, then averaged in SQL across the top-10 population.

issues.issue: Most customers do not have a populated parent_customer_id; parent roll-up logic was applied where present but had limited effect.
1488 invoice lines have null service period start/end, limiting independent recurring-revenue restatement support.
96 FY2025 invoices have null payment_date and remain unpaid in collections analysis as of the observation date.

unsupported_metrics.reason: Available monthly ARR data supports beginning and ending ARR movement categories but does not distinguish reactivation separately from new logo ARR without prior-period churn state logic beyond the required start/end bridge.
